policy.rule: Being publicly discoverable does not by itself make operational/security details appropriate to aggregate. Show only officially released visitor, mission, historical and educational information.
policy.mapPrecision: For restricted/strategic facilities, show only general facility location and officially designated public visitor/viewing points; never route users through restricted areas.

sites.name: Kennedy Space Center
sites.publicAccess: Public visitation is through Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex and designated public launch-viewing offerings; operational NASA areas require authorization/sponsorship.
sites.mapPolicy: General KSC location, Visitor Complex, and officially published public viewing information only. Do not provide restricted-area routing, gate procedures, access-control layouts, or security overlays.
sites.photographyPolicy: Use public visitor-area rules and NASA media guidance. On-site professional/commercial filming or access to operational areas requires applicable NASA/site authorization.
sites.educational: Earth rotation assist, launch azimuth, public range-safety concepts

sites.name: Cape Canaveral Space Force Station
sites.operator: U.S. Space Force — Space Launch Delta 45
sites.publicAccess: Restricted-access military installation; not generally open to the public. Use only current official public-affairs/visitor guidance.
sites.mapPolicy: General facility marker and separately identified officially public historical/visitor resources only. Do not provide internal navigation, pad-to-pad routing, gate/checkpoint detail, or security-feature mapping.
sites.photographyPolicy: Photography and publication involving the installation are controlled by Space Launch Delta 45 policy and applicable federal law; use only officially released imagery or content specifically authorized for public release.
sites.strength: Eastern Range launch operations supporting national-security, civil and commercial missions
sites.educational: Launch-site geography and publicly explained orbital-inclination concepts
allowedPublicInfo: official historical material cleared for public release
excludedInfoClasses: unapproved photography or derived facility mapping

sites.name: Vandenberg Space Force Base
sites.operator: U.S. Space Force — Space Launch Delta 30
sites.publicAccess: General-public installation tours are not currently offered according to the official tour page; use current official public-affairs and public heritage/viewing information only.
sites.mapPolicy: General base marker and officially public heritage/viewing resources only. Do not provide internal navigation, range-control routes, restricted launch-complex routing, or security overlays.
sites.photographyPolicy: On-base photography/publication is controlled by Vandenberg/SLD 30 policy; restricted or controlled areas require authorization. Use officially released imagery unless specific permission applies.
sites.strength: West Coast launches, including polar and sun-synchronous trajectories
sites.educational: Why west-coast geography supports public discussion of polar/sun-synchronous mission geometry

sites.name: Wallops Flight Facility
sites.publicAccess: The Wallops Visitor Center is the public-facing facility; NASA states it is the only Wallops facility open to the public. Qualifying facility tours require preregistration.
sites.mapPolicy: Route only to the official Visitor Center/public launch-viewing area. Do not route users to the main base or island gate or map nonpublic working areas.
sites.photographyPolicy: Follow NASA/Visitor Center rules and use officially released media for operational areas.
sites.strength: Sounding rockets, suborbital research, selected orbital launches and research aviation
sites.educational: Sounding rockets, coastal launch operations and public range-safety concepts

sites.name: Guiana Space Centre (Centre Spatial Guyanais)
sites.operator: CNES (Europe’s Spaceport; used with ESA and launch partners)
sites.publicAccess: Controlled industrial/strategic site. Official guided visits and public launch-viewing arrangements are available subject to operational and safety restrictions.
sites.mapPolicy: General spaceport location plus CNES-designated public visitor/viewing information only. Do not map internal security systems, restricted routes, or operational protection zones.
sites.photographyPolicy: CNES states that restrictions apply to aerial, panoramic and high-vantage photography; press access requires accreditation. Use official media libraries and current visitor instructions.
sites.educational: Latitude and Earth-rotation advantages for eastward launches
allowedPublicInfo: official media-library material subject to credits
excludedInfoClasses: no-fly/protection operational detail beyond official public notice

sites.name: Tanegashima Space Center
sites.publicAccess: Access is controlled. JAXA publishes guided-tour information and official launch-day observation guidance; keep-out rules apply during launch operations.
sites.mapPolicy: Use JAXA-published public visitor/observation information only. Do not generate routes through keep-out or operational areas.
sites.photographyPolicy: Use only locations/content allowed by current JAXA visitor rules; JAXA materials and logo are subject to JAXA site policy and attribution/permission requirements.
sites.strength: Japan’s primary large orbital launch center
sites.educational: Launch corridors, Pacific downrange geography and national launch infrastructure
excludedInfoClasses: commercial reuse of JAXA media without permission

sites.name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC SHAR)
sites.publicAccess: ISRO identifies the launch-view gallery as the public launch-day access path, subject to registration and current mission rules.
sites.mapPolicy: Show general spaceport location and official public Launch View Gallery context only; no internal routing or security/access-detail overlays.
sites.photographyPolicy: Follow current official visitor/launch-view rules. Reuse of ISRO-owned website material must be accurate, non-misleading and source-credited; third-party material requires separate rights.
sites.educational: Site latitude, mission inclination and public launch-viewing education
allowedPublicInfo: ISRO-owned material used consistently with copyright policy

sites.name: Baikonur Cosmodrome
sites.operator: Complex under Kazakhstan sovereignty; leased to the Russian Federation through 2050; operations include Russian and Kazakhstan entities
sites.publicAccess: Tourism is permit-controlled. Kazakhstan authorities direct visitors to lawful/authorized tourism channels and specifically warn against unauthorized entry.
sites.mapPolicy: General cosmodrome location and officially designated tourism/viewing information only. Do not provide unauthorized entry routes, internal facility navigation, security layouts, or abandoned-site infiltration guidance.
sites.photographyPolicy: Follow permit/tour-operator instructions and applicable Kazakhstan/Russian rules for the specific visit. Do not assume general photography permission.
sites.educational: Spaceflight history, international governance and public launch-tourism context
